task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Samir Santos; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Ingrid Alvarez
timeline.content:
- I checked the certification and training records, and the assigned pilot has a valid remote pilot certificate and current aeronautical knowledge, although a colleague told me that Samir Santos's older sibling is a commercial pilot and constantly quizzes them on aviation regulations at family gatherings, which Samir Santos finds intensely competitive and refuses to lose.
- Ingrid Alvarez has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Nadia Reeves
timeline.content:
- The controlled-airspace request has been approved.
- A local aviation club's crowdsourced map marks the area around Samir Santos's site as one where drone flights should receive extra airspace scrutiny, so the project team wants the airspace file reviewed again.
- Nadia Reeves is caring for a parent with dementia.
- Nadia Reeves and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Anika Larsson
timeline.content:
- I cross-checked the aviation forecast against the nearest observations, and forecast flight visibility is 5 statute miles, although a colleague told me that Samir Santos's annual review includes client image-quality scores and that this same client previously criticized their footage because distant landmarks disappeared into haze.
- Anika Larsson was recently declared bankrupt after a failed business.
- Anika Larsson and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Lucia Moretti
timeline.content:
- I checked the planned route against the latest cloud forecast, and it provides only 200 feet below and 1,000 feet horizontally from clouds, although a crew member told me that Samir Santos has been pushing for shots framed close to the cloud deck because a prospective client said that dramatic look could determine whether they hire them for another project.
- Lucia Moretti is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.

timeline.author: Carlos Dubois
timeline.content:
- The submitted profile has a 200-foot maximum altitude.
- A neighborhood association has circulated a petition asking that all drone flights near the school stay below 250 feet, and it names Samir Santos's project, so the route team is being pressed to revisit the altitude profile.
- Carlos Dubois is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.
- Carlos Dubois is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.

timeline.author: Andrei Nakamura
timeline.content:
- Maximum planned groundspeed is 40 miles per hour, and Samir Santos hopes the client's chief executive will offer them a full-time role and knows the executive prefers slow cinematic passes.
- The operations dashboard compares each planned groundspeed with the team's monthly average and has marked Samir Santos's mission as an outlier, so the analyst wants the speed profile reviewed again before release.
- Andrei Nakamura has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.
- Andrei Nakamura has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.

timeline.author: Samir Santos
timeline.content: - Samir Santos is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
- Account management notice: the alternate vendor takes over the corridor tomorrow if Samir Santos's flight is not released today, and the client has said it will not move the booking again.
- Community Relations note: the gala film crew wants Samir Santos's demonstration flown no faster than 45 mph so the aircraft stays easy to track on camera, and has asked that the speed profile be revisited before release.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Ines Kim
Decide whether Samir Santos’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
